config.promptSuffix: highly detailed, realistic skin texture, natural proportions

stylePresets.label: Hyper-Realistic iPhone
stylePresets.description: Natural smartphone realism with candid framing, authentic skin texture, and subtle HDR.
stylePresets.style_prompt: Authentic iPhone photography with natural exposure, realistic skin pores, subtle HDR, slight sensor texture, candid framing, and believable smartphone depth of field.
stylePresets.negative_prompt: plastic skin, excessive beauty filters, artificial facial smoothing, fake bokeh, overprocessed HDR, distorted hands

stylePresets.label: Cinematic Movie Still
stylePresets.description: Dramatic storytelling, atmospheric depth, film grain, and widescreen composition.
stylePresets.style_prompt: Cinematic movie still with dramatic directional lighting, atmospheric depth, subtle film grain, rich contrast, realistic color grading, and a strong storytelling composition.
stylePresets.negative_prompt: flat lighting, washed-out contrast, cheap CGI appearance, oversaturated colors, awkward framing

stylePresets.label: Fashion Editorial
stylePresets.description: Magazine-ready styling with refined posture, fabric detail, and polished lighting.
stylePresets.style_prompt: High-fashion editorial photography with polished composition, controlled professional lighting, refined posture, luxurious fabric detail, clean color treatment, and magazine-ready styling.
stylePresets.negative_prompt: wrinkled clothing, muddy fabric texture, awkward posture, distorted accessories, cluttered composition

stylePresets.label: Indonesian Lifestyle Candid
stylePresets.description: Warm, authentic everyday Indonesia with local atmosphere and documentary spontaneity.
stylePresets.style_prompt: Authentic Indonesian lifestyle photography with natural tropical light, believable local surroundings, warm human atmosphere, documentary-style composition, and spontaneous everyday realism.
stylePresets.prompt_opening: An authentic Indonesian lifestyle photograph of
stylePresets.negative_prompt: generic western streetscape, sterile studio look, unrealistic tropical vegetation, artificial skin smoothing

stylePresets.label: Japanese Nostalgia 1980s
stylePresets.description: Warm Showa-era mood with faded film color, halation, and nostalgic analog texture.
stylePresets.style_prompt: Nostalgic 1980s Japanese analog photography with warm Showa-era atmosphere, gently faded film colors, soft halation around lights, fine grain, and authentic vintage commercial styling.
stylePresets.prompt_opening: A nostalgic 1980s Japanese film photograph of
stylePresets.negative_prompt: modern LED showroom aesthetic, ultra-clean digital sharpness, futuristic signage, sterile contemporary interior

stylePresets.label: Miniature Diorama
stylePresets.description: Handcrafted scale-model realism with macro depth, tiny textures, and collectible presentation.
stylePresets.style_prompt: Ultra-detailed miniature diorama photography with handcrafted scale-model textures, realistic tiny materials, macro-lens perspective, shallow depth of field, subtle tilt-shift character, and museum-quality presentation.
stylePresets.prompt_opening: An ultra-detailed miniature diorama photograph of
stylePresets.negative_prompt: full-scale environment, life-size proportions, flat plastic toy appearance, missing handcrafted texture, excessive blur

settings.label: Small indoor live music venue (Indoor)
settings.prompt: in a small indoor live music venue with a cozy, vintage, and intimate atmosphere. The compact stage is slightly elevated and framed by a golden arch with round warm yellow light bulbs, creating a glowing theatrical look. The backdrop of the stage features deep red wallpaper with subtle gold diamond patterns. In the upper center of the backdrop, there there is a silver metallic mesh panel. In front of the mesh panel, glowing warm yellow LED neon signage spells out:  The Prompters Cafe , mounted elegantly across the top center of the mesh. The ceiling above the stage is gently arched, covered in warm-toned wood panels, adding to the capsule-like acoustic room vibe. The stage is filled with musical equipment: a bass drum and snare off to the side, a black amplifier with knobs and a beverage can placed on top, a few microphone stands, and visible instrument cables and pedals on the dark stage floor. The overall room lighting is warm and soft, with most of the illumination coming from the stage lights

settings.label: Space cockpit (Indoor)

A white reflective astronaut helmet lies on the ground next to her. Outside the window, the Earth appears in stunning detail   a vibrant blue planet with visible cloud patterns, floating in the blackness of space

compatibilityRules.message: Selfie poses work best in settings with a mirror, bedroom, bathroom, fitting room, car, or retail interior.
This mirror pose needs a setting that includes a visible mirror.
Bed poses are most believable in a bedroom, bed, or hotel-room setting.
Bathing poses require a bathroom, shower, bathtub, pool, or other water-based setting.
Running and jogging poses fit outdoor, park, street, track, or sport settings.
Sport actions look more natural with sportswear or a casual outfit.
Combat or mecha poses pair best with armor, tactical, sci-fi, or superhero outfits.
Combat scenes are stronger in sci-fi, industrial, desert, or fantasy environments.
Vehicle poses need a car, transport, garage, hangar, or space-station setting.
Fantasy and dragon poses work best in fantasy or dramatic natural environments.
Swimwear is most coherent in a pool, beach, resort, bathroom, or water-based setting.
Sleepwear looks most natural in a bedroom, bed, hotel, or home interior.
Intimate outfits are usually more coherent in private indoor or studio settings.
Sportswear pairs naturally with gym, sport, park, and outdoor settings.
Traditional outfits work well in formal, garden, cultural, urban, or village settings.
Formal fashion works best in hotels, events, urban architecture, or retail settings.
Sci-fi, armor, and superhero outfits fit futuristic, industrial, fantasy, or space settings.
Religious settings should not be paired with lingerie, swimwear, or revealing outfits.
Religious settings should not be paired with sensual or bathing poses.
Sleepy or asleep expressions are more believable in a bedroom, bed, home, or hotel setting.
Sensual expressions are more coherent in private indoor or studio settings.
Sensual poses are incompatible with religious settings.
School uniforms work best in school, library, urban, or indoor settings.
Post-apocalyptic outfits fit desert, industrial, or ruined environments.
Water-based settings often look most natural with swimwear, casual, or sportswear outfits.
